text:
Maya K: Quick heads-up — release train 7 is coming up. I'm slotted to push the search-optim change at 09:30 PT (30m window). Need someone to take the deploy baton + canary + rollback owner. Also flag if the DB migration needs a separate slot.
Ravi S: I can own the deploy and canary. I'll be on standby from 09:15. Who's running the post-deploy smoke suite?
Sasha L: @Ravi S I can run the smoke tests. I'll trigger the standard `ci/smoke-search` job and watch metrics for 20m. Outline:
- run smoke job
- confirm p95 < 120ms on search
- spot-check user flows (create, search, close)
Eli P: FYI the search-optim change includes a short online schema tweak (no full migration). Might require a 2-min pause if we see key errors. I can remote in if anything funky shows up.
Zoe C: If the schema tweak causes a blip, recommend rollback flow: rollback tag `rtrain7-prev` -> clear caches -> monitor. @Ravi S can you confirm you have the rollback tag at hand?
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket #DT-7821 now OPEN for train-7/window-09:30. CI status: green. Lockfile: none.
Ravi S: Confirmed — I have `rtrain7-prev`. I'll run the rollback script if we see >5% error rate or persistent 500s after 5m. My quick rollback command: `scripts/rollback --tag rtrain7-prev --force`.
Maya K: Great. @Sasha L please paste the exact smoke commands you'll run so I can document in the ticket.
Sasha L: Copy-paste:
```
./ci/run_smoke.sh --suite smoke-search --timeout 1200
./tools/check_metrics.sh --service search --window 5m --metric p95 --threshold 120
```
I'll also ping here if anything blocks.
Eli P: I'll keep DB console open and monitor for slow DDL locks. If I see locks >30s I'll call for immediate rollback.
Zoe C: Minor ask: let's stagger the rollout traffic to 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m increments. Keeps blast radius small.
Ravi S: Ack. Deploy plan:
- 09:30 deploy to canary nodes (20%)
- 09:40 expand to 50%
- 09:50 full (100%) if green
I'll update the ticket with timestamps.
Maya K: Perfect. Logging owner: Ravi S (deploy + rollback), Sasha L (smoke), Eli P (DB), Zoe C (traffic pacing). Thanks everyone — I'll mark the train as staffed in the release doc. :thumbsup:
Ravi S: I'll post a short postmortem note in the ticket if anything unusual happens. See you all at 09:15 in case we need to pair.
Sasha L: will be there. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 09:15 PT — release train 7 preflight check (30m before).
